title_en: In the aviation field, 1+1 apartment with regular layout for sale!
description_en: 1+1 apartment with regular layout for sale at the aviation field!! The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an 8-story building with an elevator. The property has a gross area of ​​68 m2 and a net area of ​​58.88 m2. The apartment is organized in a living room together with a kitchen corner, a matrimonial room, and a day toilet. The orientation of the apartment is south, providing light and views. Currently, the construction is in the carbine phase on the 5th floor and is expected to be completed within a period of 1.5-2 years.
